title: threadlight-connect manifest
description: Emitted by threadlight-connect (scripts/connect.py) after an evidence-based mock-to-real integration-swap assessment. Extends the shared envelope from skills/_shared/manifest.py (schema, tool_version, generated_at, freshness, status, findings) with connect-specific payload fields. Contains no credentials, tokens, or customer payloads — evidence is summarized to booleans and role names only.

findings.description: Exactly the four stable live-leg gap-evidence findings, one each, in order: INT-001 (contract conformance), INT-002 (runtime mock->real binding), INT-003 (OBO user-scoped identity), INT-004 (required-role revalidation / apply). IDs are never dynamic — field-level conformance detail lives in conformance.differences.

integration_state.description: Persisted current state — the state as of the last SUCCESSFUL apply. Never edited on a failed or unverified transition.

target_state.description: The state computed purely from this run's conformance + evidence, independent of whether --apply was passed.

evaluated.description: False when the captured real response had no items to check. An unevaluated result is insufficient evidence — never a vacuous pass — and targets real-unverified, distinct from real-drift.

item_count.description: Number of real records actually checked. 0 means unevaluated (insufficient evidence).

actual.description: e.g. 'missing' or an observed type name

evidence_summary.description: Booleans + role names only — never the raw OBO/role evidence payload (which may carry tokens) and never the real endpoint URL (which lives only in mcp-config.json).

endpoint_configured.description: A validated real endpoint was supplied this run (URL itself is never persisted here).

endpoint_verified.description: The verified real endpoint binding was persisted by a successful --apply (never true on a dry run).

apply_plan.description: File-by-file plan. Always populated, even when apply=false (dry run).

changed_paths.description: Every path actually written this run. Empty unless apply=true AND target_state == real-verified.
